rawContent: The NYPD can’t stop spying on completely legal, constitutionally-protected activities. #BlackLivesMatter #ChangetheNYPD
Catch @Lumumbabandele & @MJWilliams_Law on @bbc5live speaking now about NYPD surveillance of #BlackLivesMatter: https://t.co/WrEAQIs8RX

“What they are doing is quite frankly illegal, even though it is part of longstanding practices and patterns of the NYPD.” -@Lumumbabandele on NYPD surveillance of #BlackLivesMatter activists revealed in FOIA release obtained by @MJWilliams_Law
